proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_grant family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord only has spell | class_feature | mastery. There is no species_trait kind. Damage Resistance is a passive, permanent trait with no activation cost, no resource, and no rest reset — none of the existing mechanics families (activation, ongoing_effect, on_hit_trigger, etc.) can encode it honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance with damage_type parameterized by character-creation choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The resistance type is not fixed at encoding time — it is determined by the Draconic Ancestry trait choice at character creation. The surface has no mechanism to express 'damage type chosen at character creation' as a parameter on grant_resistance.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits... You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

notes: grant_resistance exists as a v4 effect atom (taxonomy §9) so the atom itself is not missing. The gap is structural: (1) no SpeciesTraitRecord kind in UnitRecord; (2) no passive_grant or analogous mechanics family; (3) no surface-level way to express a damage type that is a character-creation parameter rather than a fixed value. All three gaps must be closed together before this unit can be encoded honestly.
